backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual net_income and operating_cash_flow are known by their SEC filed date (<= signal date) and matched on the same fiscal year period end; total assets uses the latest filed value. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: Production-universe names whose most recent annual earnings are backed by operating cash flow (low accruals / high cash-conversion) and that show liquid SPY-relative price confirmation may be higher-quality, less-reversal-prone demand than generic momentum.
interpretation: The accruals / cash-conversion source is positively predictive (all-window positive EV/PnL beating the accepted comparators on gross deltas, concentration clean) but was REJECTED on drawdown drift: at 369 overlaid paper trades it is a large momentum-tilted sleeve whose drawdown exceeds the guardrail. It is a lead for a drawdown-aware, smaller-deployment redesign, not a promotable fixed bundle. Do not tune this fixed definition on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs a materially different earnings-quality construction (for example PIT TTM accruals with same-period cash flow, change-in-accruals momentum, or forward replacement-value rows), not a sweep of cash-conversion, accruals, freshness, RS, close, volume, top-N, hold, or cooldown thresholds on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping cash-conversion ratio, accruals/assets threshold, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: The positive-EV-but-drawdown-failing readout means the next valid test is a DIFFERENT decision hypothesis: a drawdown-aware deployment of this quality source (concurrent-position cap, per-name protective stop, or a risk-budgeted sub-sleeve) sized to the accepted comparators, or a sharper quality discriminator (PIT TTM same-period accruals, accrual-change momentum, or quarterly cash-flow when reported) that selects fewer, higher-conviction names. A drawdown-controlled redesign is not a threshold sweep of this rejected fixed bundle.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.9921; aggregate PnL delta $+21,322.65; max drawdown drift +0.0522; 369 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected on drawdown drift only. The accruals / cash-conversion quality source was positively predictive: aggregate EV +0.9921 and PnL $+21,322.65 with positive EV/PnL in all three windows and no regression, beating the accepted compression and distribution comparators on the gross deltas, and concentration passed. The binding failure is that 369 paper trades (~1/day held 10 days, ~10 concurrent positions of momentum-confirmed quality names) form a large, highly-deployed sleeve whose drawdown drift (+0.0522) exceeds the 0.5pp guardrail. The gross-delta beat over the much smaller accepted comparators is partly a deployment-size artifact, not proven risk-adjusted superiority; 36/47 universe names pass the quality gate, so selection is discriminated mostly by price confirmation, i.e. the sleeve behaves like a broad cash-conversion-tilted momentum overlay.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose most recent annual earnings are backed by operating cash flow (low accruals / high cash-conversion) and that show liquid SPY-relative price confirmation are higher-quality, less-reversal-prone demand.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-016/017/019: Accepted/rejected fundamental_growth_rs Companyfacts support fields (filing recency, low liability, working capital) ride the accepted operating-profit + RS sleeve; none use cash-flow-vs-earnings accruals, which the CompanyfactsFundamentalIndex never loads.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-003: Rejected low-capex-intensity support; capex/revenue is a different capital-intensity field, not earnings-quality accruals.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-007: Rejected SEC earnings-catalyst peer underreaction; this run is a direct single-name fundamental-quality source, not a peer relation.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The accruals anomaly (Sloan 1996) is a robust, economically distinct earnings-quality effect; net_income and operating_cash_flow exist in the PIT companyfacts archive but the accepted fundamental index never loads them, so this is genuinely untested free data. Main disconfirmer: in a momentum-led liquid universe the cash-conversion gate may merely re-select existing winners and fail to beat the accepted candidate-pool comparators after costs.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual net_income/operating_cash_flow on a matching fiscal year end, missing assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual accruals / cash-conversion quality gate, the same liquid SPY-relative confirmation, core-overlap context, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
